reproducer.description: docs/native-testing.md 'Known test-system gap' at mncs-math@cb1d32b: scalar abs_checked(MIN) and float division-by-zero are pinned via traps corpora because no native assertion can own them.

requiredBehavior: A native assertion or test-role expressing an expected structured failure (trap with operation/input/contract identity) that passes when the body traps as specified and fails otherwise.
summary: mncs-test assertions cover passing values (equals_i64/bool/bytes) and the suite counts runtime failures, but a test body that traps reports a failure, never a pass. Mathematical libraries therefore cannot express 'this input must trap' natively; mncs-math keeps all trapping behavior in *-traps-corpus.json execution corpora instead.
title: Native tests cannot assert expected traps (no structured failure expectations)
